states.name: un-intervention
states.description: Turn 4, AR 3, the US to act holding UN Intervention, Fidel (a USSR card, 2 ops, Cuba US 2), Containment (its own) and Asia Scoring. UN Intervention is played with Fidel: Fidel's event is cancelled and the US uses its 2 operations.

states.name: un-intervention-no-partner
states.description: The US holds UN Intervention but no card with a USSR event (only its own Containment and a scoring card): the event can't be played.

states.name: un-cancels-we-will-bury-you
states.description: We Will Bury You has just been played: the US's next action round (this one) ends with the USSR gaining 3 VP — unless the US plays UN Intervention as an event, here with Fidel.

states.name: un-after-u2
states.description: U2 Incident was played earlier this turn: UN Intervention, played by the US with Fidel, pays the USSR 1 more VP.

states.name: ussr-un-intervention
states.description: The USSR holds UN Intervention and Duck and Cover (a US card, 3 ops): played together, the event is cancelled and the USSR uses 3 operations.

states.name: u2-incident
states.description: The USSR to act holding U2 Incident: +1 VP now, and the effect lasts the rest of the turn.

states.name: ask-not
states.description: The US to act holding Ask Not What Your Country… and four other cards (one a scoring card), with a five-card deck: it marks any of its cards to discard and draws as many from the top of the deck.

states.name: ask-not-empty-hand
states.description: The US holds only Ask Not What Your Country…: nothing to discard, so the event does nothing.

states.name: ask-not-reshuffle
states.description: As ask-not, but the deck is empty and three cards are in the discard pile: replacements come from the discard pile reshuffled — including the cards just discarded.

states.name: tehran
states.description: The US to act holding Our Man in Tehran and controlling Israel (a Middle East country); the deck holds eight cards. It draws the top five, marks which to discard, and the rest return to a reshuffled deck.

states.name: tehran-no-control
states.description: As tehran, but the US controls no Middle East country: the event does nothing and the deck is untouched.
